paraphrase: Title, icon, description, developer name, screenshots and promotional images must be honest, well written, relevant and suitable for all audiences: no unattributed testimonials, no keyword blocks, no emoji or repeated special characters in the title, icon or developer name, no all-caps outside a brand name, no misleading icon symbols, no claims of ranking, price or a Play programme, no sexual, profane or violent imagery; the title is at most 30 characters.
quote: Your app title must be 30 characters or less.
